# v0.18.15 stalled-worker recovery and evidence

An established Universal worker that freezes may be handed to the existing
delayed checkpoint recovery even when resume_required was still false. Validate
the frozen compiled Plan, stage ledger, Bridge handshake and fixed geometry;
lock Controller input before termination and confirm the old process exited.
Stop/Pause/Human/terminal/completed boundaries win. Preserve checkpoint bytes,
uncertain purchase/Confirm intents, attempt budgets and every replay guard.
The bounded stall claim must survive retries and permit a later loop to recover.

AUTO-RECOVERING means a real pending or active recovery path. A terminal
archive/reset boundary must say RESET REQUIRED; an unscheduled blocked state
must not claim that recovery is running.

SEND LOG includes compact failure/recovery history from retained worker logs,
with explicit coverage limits and no raw tool arguments, image data or agent
prose. Active current-frame previews precede historical/reset-job previews.
Diagnostic snapshots can straddle a transaction; pending in one state copy
is not evidence of failure when later journal records prove its commit.
Previews and history never grant native input or replay authority.

# v0.18.15 — Recovery Watchdog

แก้ worker ที่ค้างก่อนตั้ง resume_required ให้ส่งต่อ checkpoint ไปกู้คืนได้
ตรวจ Plan/Stage/Bridge และปิดสิทธิ์ input ก่อนยุติ worker เดิม
แสดง AUTO-RECOVERING เฉพาะเมื่อมีเส้นทางกู้คืนจริง และแยก RESET REQUIRED
เก็บประวัติเหตุขัดข้องจาก worker logs ที่ยังมีอยู่ พร้อมให้ภาพงานปัจจุบันมาก่อนภาพเก่า
รายการอ่านสมบัติ/วัตถุดิบยังถูกปิดตาม v0.18.14

ดูรายละเอียดใน RELEASE_v0.18.15_TH.md

# Axiom Vision v0.18.15 — Recovery Watchdog

แก้เส้นทาง Auto Recovery ที่ทดสอบจำลองให้เกิดซ้ำได้
- worker ค้างใหม่ยังไม่ตั้ง resume_required จึงไม่ผ่านเงื่อนไขกู้คืนเดิม
- ยืนยัน Bridge/Plan/Stage/geometry และปิดสิทธิ์ input ก่อนยุติ worker
  รอ process เดิมจบ แล้วส่ง checkpoint เดิมเข้า recovery/backoff ที่มีอยู่
- เคารพการปิด autonomous recovery และไม่ให้ Stop/Pause/Human/terminal/completion
  ถูกการกู้คืนเขียนทับ ไม่ล้าง intent, purchase, Confirm หรือ attempt budget
- no-fresh-frame ไม่บังการจัดการ worker ที่ยืนยันว่าไม่ตอบสนองแล้ว
- แยกสถานะ RESET REQUIRED/NEEDS REVIEW จาก AUTO-RECOVERING ที่มีคิวจริง

ปรับ Send Log เพื่อเก็บหลักฐานที่ใช้ตรวจปัญหาได้
- เพิ่มประวัติ failure/recovery แบบย่อจาก worker log และไฟล์หมุนเวียนที่ยังอยู่
  แยกจาก tail ปกติ เพื่อไม่ให้รอบที่ทำงานสำเร็จดันเหตุขัดข้องหายง่าย
- บอกขอบเขตข้อมูลที่เก็บได้ ไม่อ้างว่าเป็นประวัติทั้งหมด
- ให้ภาพปัจจุบันของงานที่กำลังทำมาก่อนภาพ OCR เก่า/Heart ที่ reset แล้ว
  ส่งไฟล์ ZIP เดียวตามงบเดิม state หลักยังตรงทุกไบต์
- ภาพ preview ใช้ดูประกอบเท่านั้น ไม่ใช้อนุญาตคลิกหรือเป็นหลักฐาน OCR ต้นฉบับ

ข้อเท็จจริงจาก diagnostic v0.18.14 รอบ 17 ตุลาคม
- batch ล่าสุดจบ 12 รอบในช่วง 02:39–03:39 น. เวลาประเทศไทย
- tail ที่ได้รับมี 5 รอบสำเร็จติดต่อกัน ไม่มีเหตุ recovery/error ใหม่
- pending Multi-Buy ใน snapshot มีบันทึก dispatch/commit สำเร็จตามมา
- ข้อมูลชุดนี้จึงยังพิสูจน์ไม่ได้ว่าช่องโหว่ที่แก้เป็นสาเหตุของอาการที่ผู้ใช้เห็น

ระบบอ่านรายการสมบัติ/วัตถุดิบยังปิดอยู่ตาม v0.18.14
Universal Revision 9, Heart Revision 13, dependency pins, never-replay guards,
freshness, geometry, watchdog/runtime budgets และ Human Verification คงเดิม

อัปเดตจาก Settings → CHECK UPDATE และหยุด worker/ปิด Controller เมื่อติดตั้ง
updater จะเลื่อนการติดตั้งระหว่างมีงานหรือ active checkpoint ตามกฎเดิม
เก็บ runtime state เดิม ไม่ต้อง Reset Batch เพื่อรับอัปเดต

ทดสอบด้วย replay/จำลองและ updater บน Linux
ยังไม่ได้ทดสอบ native Windows/LDPlayer ด้วยรุ่นนี้

"""Read-only, bounded recovery history for diagnostic bundles.

Normal observations do not evict failure records. The result describes only the
retained worker log and its known rotations, never a complete incident history.
Tool arguments, content, screenshots, and agent messages are never traversed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Any

MAX_HISTORY_BYTES = 32_000
MAX_EVENTS = 80
MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 8_000_000
MAX_TOTAL_SOURCE_BYTES = 32_000_000
MAX_LINE_BYTES = 65_536
MAX_SOURCE_LINES = 100_000
_IDENTIFIER = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,96}\Z")
_SESSION = re.compile(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,64}\Z")
_SENSITIVE = re.compile(
    r"(?:token|password|passwd|secret|credential|authorization|bearer|api[_ -]?key|"
    r"data:|https?://|[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{65,})", re.IGNORECASE,
)
_RECOVERY_EVENT = re.compile(
    r"(?:^|_)(?:blocked|block|error|failed|failure|timeout|recovery|recover|"
    r"retry|supervisor|review|aborted|rejected|stalled)(?:_|$)"
)
_CONTROLLER_RECOVERY_EVENTS = {
    "stall_recovery_input_locked", "stall_recovery_termination_failed",
    "stall_recovery_scheduled", "stall_recovery_cancelled",
}
_RECOVERY_TOOLS = {
    "visionstudio_confirm_resume_stage",
    "visionstudio_recover_stage",
    "visionstudio_resume_after_human",
}


def _identifier(value: Any) -> str | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, str) and _IDENTIFIER.fullmatch(value) else None


def _reason(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        return None
    # Inspect before truncating so a secret suffix cannot evade redaction.
    if len(value) > 2_000 or _SENSITIVE.search(value):
        return "<redacted sensitive diagnostic text>"
    return " ".join(value.split())[:160]


def _timestamp(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 40:
        return None
    try:
        datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return value


def _selected_event(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return None
    kind = payload.get("type")
    if not isinstance(kind, str):
        return None
    fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
    data = payload
    if kind == "axiom.controller_recovery":
        event = _identifier(payload.get("event"))
        if not event or event not in _CONTROLLER_RECOVERY_EVENTS:
            return None
        fields["event"] = event
        code = _identifier(payload.get("error_code"))
        mode = payload.get("mode")
        if mode in ("local", "codex"):
            fields["mode"] = mode
        checkpoint_key = payload.get("checkpoint_key")
        if isinstance(checkpoint_key, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", checkpoint_key):
            fields["checkpoint_key"] = checkpoint_key
        next_at = _timestamp(payload.get("next_at"))
        if next_at:
            fields["next_at"] = next_at
    elif kind == "axiom.local_runner":
        event = _identifier(payload.get("event"))
        restored = event == "mission_started" and payload.get("checkpoint_restored") is True
        decision = event == "stage_decision" and payload.get("operation") in (
            "supervisor", "blocked", "recovery", "retry",
        )
        if not event or not (_RECOVERY_EVENT.search(event) or restored or decision):
            return None
        fields["event"] = event
        if restored:
            fields["checkpoint_restored"] = True
        reason = _reason(payload.get("reason") or payload.get("error"))
        if reason:
            fields["reason"] = reason
        code = _identifier(payload.get("error_code") or payload.get("incident_code"))
    elif kind == "item.completed":
        item = payload.get("item")
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "mcp_tool_call":
            return None
        tool = _identifier(item.get("tool"))
        if not tool or not tool.startswith("visionstudio_"):
            return None
        result = item.get("result")
        result = result if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
        data = result.get("structured_content", result.get("structuredContent"))
        data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        code = _identifier(data.get("error_code"))
        status = item.get("status")
        failed = status == "failed" or code is not None or result.get("is_error") is True or result.get("isError") is True
        if not failed and tool not in _RECOVERY_TOOLS:
            return None
        fields["tool"] = tool
        if status in ("failed", "completed"):
            fields["status"] = status
        fields["event"] = "tool_failed" if failed else "recovery_tool_completed"
        # Intentionally exclude result.content, item.arguments, and item.error.
        reason = _reason(data.get("reason"))
        if reason:
            fields["reason"] = reason
    elif kind in {"error", "turn.failed"}:
        data = payload.get("error")
        data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        code = _identifier(data.get("code") or payload.get("error_code"))
        fields["event"] = "worker_failed"
    else:
        return None
    fields["type"] = kind
    if code:
        fields["error_code"] = code
    timestamp = _timestamp(payload.get("timestamp"))
    if timestamp:
        fields["timestamp"] = timestamp
    stage = data.get("stage")
    stage = stage if isinstance(stage, dict) else {}
    stage_id = _identifier(data.get("stage_id") or stage.get("id"))
    if stage_id:
        fields["stage_id"] = stage_id
    session = data.get("session_id")
    if isinstance(session, str) and _SESSION.fullmatch(session):
        fields["session_id"] = session
    return fields


def _encode(record: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    return (json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def recovery_history_snapshot(
    worker_path: Path,
    *,
    max_events: int = MAX_EVENTS,
    maximum: int = MAX_HISTORY_BYTES,
    max_source_bytes: int = MAX_SOURCE_BYTES,
    max_total_source_bytes: int = MAX_TOTAL_SOURCE_BYTES,
    max_line_bytes: int = MAX_LINE_BYTES,
    max_source_lines: int = MAX_SOURCE_LINES,
) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return selected retained events and truthful coverage metadata.

    All source reads and line parsing have independent hard bounds. Files are
    visited newest source first to reserve budget for current failures; returned
    events are ordered oldest to newest. Source line numbers count physical lines,
    including malformed and overlong records. Capture is not an atomic snapshot.
    """
    # Caller options can reduce limits but cannot disable production bounds.
    max_events = max(1, min(MAX_EVENTS, max_events))
    maximum = max(4_096, min(MAX_HISTORY_BYTES, maximum))
    max_source_bytes = max(1, min(MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, max_source_bytes))
    max_total_source_bytes = max(1, min(MAX_TOTAL_SOURCE_BYTES, max_total_source_bytes))
    max_line_bytes = max(1, min(MAX_LINE_BYTES, max_line_bytes))
    max_source_lines = max(1, min(MAX_SOURCE_LINES, max_source_lines))
    selected_records: list[tuple[int, int, bytes]] = []
    source_coverage: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    total_read = total_lines = selected = 0
    for index in (0, 1, 2, 3):
        source_records: deque[tuple[int, int, bytes]] = deque(maxlen=max_events)
        path = worker_path.with_suffix(worker_path.suffix + f".{index}") if index else worker_path
        try:
            size = path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            continue
        coverage: dict[str, Any] = {
            "source": path.name, "size_at_capture": size, "bytes_read": 0,
            "lines_read": 0, "malformed_records": 0, "oversized_records": 0,
        }
        source_coverage.append(coverage)
        budget = min(max_source_bytes, max_total_source_bytes - total_read, size)
        try:
            with path.open("rb") as source:
                while coverage["bytes_read"] < budget and total_lines < max_source_lines:
                    offset = coverage["bytes_read"]
                    remaining = budget - offset
                    raw = source.readline(min(max_line_bytes + 1, remaining))
                    if not raw:
                        break
                    coverage["bytes_read"] += len(raw)
                    total_read += len(raw)
                    oversized = len(raw) > max_line_bytes
                    partial = not raw.endswith(b"\n") and coverage["bytes_read"] < size
                    if oversized or partial:
                        while not raw.endswith(b"\n") and coverage["bytes_read"] < budget:
                            raw = source.readline(min(max_line_bytes + 1, budget - coverage["bytes_read"]))
                            if not raw:
                                break
                            coverage["bytes_read"] += len(raw)
                            total_read += len(raw)
                        coverage["oversized_records"] += 1
                    coverage["lines_read"] += 1
                    total_lines += 1
                    if oversized or partial:
                        continue
                    try:
                        payload = json.loads(raw)
                    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):
                        coverage["malformed_records"] += 1
                        continue
                    event = _selected_event(payload)
                    if event is None:
                        continue
                    selected += 1
                    event.update(source=path.name, source_line=coverage["lines_read"], source_byte_offset=offset)
                    source_records.append((index, coverage["lines_read"], _encode(event)))
        except OSError:
            coverage["read_error"] = True
        coverage["scan_limited"] = coverage["bytes_read"] < size
        selected_records.extend(source_records)
    # At most four bounded per-source deques are retained. The newest source
    # takes priority for read budgets and the final selected-event limit.
    ordered = sorted(selected_records, key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
    records = deque(item[2] for item in ordered[-max_events:])
    coverage = {
        "type": "axiom.recovery_history_snapshot",
        "schema_version": 1,
        "captured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "scope": "selected events from retained worker log and up to three rotations",
        "complete_history": False,
        "atomic_snapshot": False,
        "sources_oldest_first": list(reversed(source_coverage)),
        "source_scan_priority": "current worker, then newest to oldest rotation",
        "selected_events_seen": selected,
        "events_returned": len(records),
        "events_omitted": selected - len(records),
        "limits": {"events": max_events, "output_bytes": maximum, "source_bytes_each": max_source_bytes,
                   "source_bytes_total": max_total_source_bytes, "line_bytes": max_line_bytes,
                   "source_lines_total": max_source_lines},
        "fields_are_whitelisted": True,
        "tool_arguments_and_content_excluded": True,
    }
    total = sum(map(len, records))
    while records:
        footer = _encode(coverage)
        if total + len(footer) <= maximum:
            break
        total -= len(records.popleft())
        coverage["events_returned"] = len(records)
        coverage["events_omitted"] = selected - len(records)
    return b"".join(records) + _encode(coverage), coverage

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
import json
import random
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_log_delivery as delivery


class DiagnosticDeliveryPriorityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def image(self, seed: int) -> bytes:
        image = Image.frombytes("RGB", (800, 800), random.Random(seed).randbytes(800 * 800 * 3))
        output = io.BytesIO()
        image.save(output, "PNG")
        return output.getvalue()

    def transfer(self, root: Path, members: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes], dict]:
        source = root / "diagnostic.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
            for name, content in members.items():
                archive.writestr(name, content)
        original = source.read_bytes()
        result = delivery.telegram_diagnostic_copy(source)
        self.assertNotEqual(result, source)
        self.assertEqual(source.read_bytes(), original)
        self.assertLessEqual(result.stat().st_size, delivery.SINGLE_DIAGNOSTIC_BYTES)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(result) as archive:
            selected = {name: archive.read(name) for name in archive.namelist()}
        manifest = json.loads(selected.pop("telegram-transfer.json"))
        self.assertEqual(manifest["full_bundle_sha256"], hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())
        for name, entry in manifest["members"].items():
            self.assertEqual(entry["source_sha256"], hashlib.sha256(members[name]).hexdigest())
            if entry["mode"] != "omitted":
                self.assertEqual(entry["output_sha256"], hashlib.sha256(selected[entry["output_member"]]).hexdigest())
        return original, selected, manifest

    def test_active_universal_preview_precedes_reset_heart_and_old_ocr_image(self):
        state = json.dumps({"desired_state": "running", "diagnostic_fixture": random.Random(4).randbytes(100_000).hex()}).encode()
        members = {
            "diagnostic-report.json": b'{"runtime":{"latest_frame_sha256":"current"}}',
            "state/controller-state.json": state,
            "state/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"active","pending_action_intent":{"replay_policy":"never"}}',
            "heart-sender/state.json": b'{"desired_state":"idle"}',
            "heart-sender/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"reset"}',
            "images/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(11),
            "images/result-ocr-failure.png": self.image(12),
            "heart-sender/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(13),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, selected, manifest = self.transfer(Path(tmp), members)
        self.assertIn("images/latest-frame.preview.jpg", selected)
        for name in ("state/controller-state.json", "state/checkpoint.json", "heart-sender/state.json", "heart-sender/checkpoint.json"):
            self.assertEqual(selected[name], members[name])
        preview = manifest["members"]["images/latest-frame.jpg"]
        self.assertEqual(preview["retention_priority"], "preferred_current_preview")
        self.assertFalse(preview["lossless"])
        self.assertFalse(preview["input_authority"])
        self.assertLess(max(preview["preview_dimensions"]), 800)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["images/result-ocr-failure.png"]["mode"], "omitted")
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["heart-sender/latest-frame.jpg"]["mode"], "omitted")

    def test_active_heart_preview_precedes_idle_universal_image(self):
        members = {
            "diagnostic-report.json": b'{"runtime":{},"heart_sender":{}}',
            "state/controller-state.json": b'{"desired_state":"idle"}',
            "state/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"completed"}',
            "heart-sender/state.json": b'{"desired_state":"running"}',
            "heart-sender/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"active","phase":"await-send-result"}',
            "images/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(21),
            "images/result-ocr-failure.png": self.image(22),
            "heart-sender/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(23),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, selected, manifest = self.transfer(Path(tmp), members)
        self.assertIn("heart-sender/latest-frame.preview.jpg", selected)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["heart-sender/latest-frame.jpg"]["retention_priority"], "preferred_current_preview")
        self.assertEqual(selected["heart-sender/checkpoint.json"], members["heart-sender/checkpoint.json"])

    def test_recovery_history_survives_large_healthy_tail_without_inventing_events(self):
        failure = {"event": "recovery_scheduled", "timestamp": "2026-10-16T18:00:00+00:00", "stage_id": "confirm-rewards", "mode": "local"}
        coverage = {"event": "recovery_history_coverage", "matched_records": 1, "returned_records": 1}
        history = b"".join(json.dumps(row).encode() + b"\n" for row in (failure, coverage))
        healthy = b"".join(json.dumps({"event": "stage_decision", "operation": "wait", "sample": n,
                                       "fixture": random.Random(n).randbytes(500).hex()}).encode() + b"\n" for n in range(300))
        members = {
            "diagnostic-report.json": b'{"runtime":{}}',
            "state/controller-state.json": b'{"desired_state":"running"}',
            "state/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"active"}',
            "logs/recovery-history.jsonl": history,
            "logs/worker-tail.jsonl": healthy,
            "images/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(31),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, selected, manifest = self.transfer(Path(tmp), members)
        self.assertEqual(selected["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"], history)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"]["mode"], "exact")
        self.assertNotIn(failure["timestamp"].encode(), selected["logs/worker-tail.jsonl"])
        self.assertGreater(manifest["members"]["logs/worker-tail.jsonl"]["omitted_prefix_bytes"], 0)
        self.assertEqual([json.loads(line) for line in selected["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"].splitlines()], [failure, coverage])
        self.assertIn("images/latest-frame.preview.jpg", selected)

    def test_unbound_review_file_does_not_displace_current_universal_preview(self):
        members = {
            "diagnostic-report.json": b'{"runtime":{"active_review_id":null,"active_review_witness":{"included":false,"sha256_matches":false}}}',
            "state/controller-state.json": b'{"desired_state":"running"}',
            "state/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"active"}',
            "images/active-review-witness.png": self.image(41),
            "images/latest-frame.jpg": self.image(42),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, selected, manifest = self.transfer(Path(tmp), members)
        self.assertIn("images/latest-frame.preview.jpg", selected)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["images/latest-frame.jpg"]["retention_priority"], "preferred_current_preview")

    def test_recovery_history_stays_exact_when_ordinary_tail_uses_smaller_profile(self):
        rows = [{"event": "recovery_scheduled", "stage_id": "confirm-rewards", "sample": n,
                 "diagnostic_fixture": random.Random(n).randbytes(128).hex()} for n in range(75)]
        rows.append({"event": "recovery_history_coverage", "matched_records": 75, "returned_records": 75})
        history = b"".join(json.dumps(row).encode() + b"\n" for row in rows)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(history), 32_000)
        healthy = b"".join(json.dumps({"event": "stage_decision", "sample": n,
                                       "diagnostic_fixture": random.Random(n + 1000).randbytes(500).hex()}).encode() + b"\n" for n in range(300))
        members = {
            "diagnostic-report.json": b'{"runtime":{}}',
            "state/controller-state.json": json.dumps({"desired_state": "running", "diagnostic_fixture": random.Random(5).randbytes(130_000).hex()}).encode(),
            "state/checkpoint.json": b'{"status":"active"}',
            "logs/recovery-history.jsonl": history,
            "logs/worker-tail.jsonl": healthy,
            "rewards/01-frame.png": self.image(51),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, selected, manifest = self.transfer(Path(tmp), members)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(selected["logs/worker-tail.jsonl"]), 16 * 1024)
        self.assertEqual(selected["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"], history)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["members"]["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"]["mode"], "exact")
        self.assertEqual([json.loads(line) for line in selected["logs/recovery-history.jsonl"].splitlines()], rows)
        self.assertEqual(selected["state/controller-state.json"], members["state/controller-state.json"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_recovery_diagnostics as diagnostics


def failure(code="semantic_reward_scene_unavailable", **extra):
    return {
        "type": "item.completed",
        "item": {
            "type": "mcp_tool_call", "tool": "visionstudio_execute_fixed_stage_target",
            "status": "failed", "result": {"structured_content": {"error_code": code}},
            **extra,
        },
    }


def local(event, **extra):
    return {"type": "axiom.local_runner", "event": event, **extra}


class RecoveryDiagnosticTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def write(self, path, rows):
        path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in rows))

    def snapshot(self, path, **options):
        content, metadata = diagnostics.recovery_history_snapshot(path, **options)
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in content.splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1], metadata)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(content), diagnostics.MAX_HISTORY_BYTES)
        return rows[:-1], metadata, content

    def test_failure_survives_one_thousand_successful_stage_events(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [failure()] + [local("stage_decision", operation="act", stage_id="lobby-play") for _ in range(1000)])
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 1)
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["error_code"], "semantic_reward_scene_unavailable")
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["source_line"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["lines_read"], 1001)
            self.assertFalse(metadata["complete_history"])

    def test_rotations_are_scanned_oldest_first_with_source_provenance(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            for index in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                source = path if not index else path.with_suffix(f".jsonl.{index}")
                self.write(source, [local("supervisor_required", incident_code=f"rotation_{index}")])
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual([row["error_code"] for row in rows], ["rotation_3", "rotation_2", "rotation_1", "rotation_0"])
            self.assertEqual([row["source"] for row in rows], ["worker.jsonl.3", "worker.jsonl.2", "worker.jsonl.1", "worker.jsonl"])
            self.assertTrue(all(row["source_line"] == 1 for row in rows))
            self.assertEqual(len(metadata["sources_oldest_first"]), 4)

    def test_only_known_fields_are_copied_and_sensitive_reason_is_redacted(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            row = failure(arguments={"password": "argument-secret"}, error="free-secret")
            row["item"]["result"]["content"] = [{"type": "image", "data": "image-secret"}, {"type": "text", "text": "text-secret"}]
            self.write(path, [row, {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "agent_message", "text": "agent-secret"}}, local("blocked", reason="API key=reason-secret"), local("blocked", reason="Known guard rejected the stage.", stage_id="confirm-rewards", session_id="a" * 32)])
            rows, _, content = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 3)
            for secret in (b"argument-secret", b"free-secret", b"image-secret", b"text-secret", b"agent-secret", b"reason-secret"):
                self.assertNotIn(secret, content)
            self.assertEqual(rows[1]["reason"], "<redacted sensitive diagnostic text>")
            self.assertEqual(rows[2]["reason"], "Known guard rejected the stage.")
            self.assertEqual(rows[2]["session_id"], "a" * 32)
            self.assertEqual(rows[2]["stage_id"], "confirm-rewards")

    def test_overlong_and_malformed_lines_do_not_hide_later_failure(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            path.write_bytes(b"{invalid}\n" + b"x" * 1000 + b"\n" + (json.dumps(failure()) + "\n").encode())
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path, max_line_bytes=512)
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["source_line"], 3)
            source = metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]
            self.assertEqual(source["malformed_records"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(source["oversized_records"], 1)
            self.assertFalse(source["scan_limited"])

    def test_source_byte_and_line_budgets_are_reported_truthfully(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [local("blocked", incident_code="safe_block")] * 100)
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path, max_source_bytes=200)
            self.assertLessEqual(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["bytes_read"], 200)
            self.assertTrue(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["scan_limited"])
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path, max_source_lines=2)
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)
            self.assertEqual(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["lines_read"], 2)
            self.assertTrue(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["scan_limited"])

    def test_total_read_budget_spans_rotations(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            for index in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                source = path if not index else path.with_suffix(f".jsonl.{index}")
                self.write(source, [local("blocked")] * 20)
            _, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path, max_total_source_bytes=200)
            self.assertLessEqual(sum(source["bytes_read"] for source in metadata["sources_oldest_first"]), 200)
            self.assertTrue(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["scan_limited"])

    def test_output_and_event_budgets_drop_oldest_selected_events(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [local("supervisor_required", incident_code=f"failure_{index}", reason="ก" * 160) for index in range(200)])
            rows, metadata, content = self.snapshot(path, maximum=4096, max_events=20)
            self.assertLessEqual(len(content), 4096)
            self.assertLessEqual(len(rows), 20)
            self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["error_code"], "failure_199")
            self.assertEqual(metadata["events_omitted"], 200 - len(rows))

    def test_successful_recovery_and_restored_checkpoint_are_selected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [local("mission_started", checkpoint_restored=False), local("mission_started", checkpoint_restored=True), {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "tool": "visionstudio_confirm_resume_stage", "status": "completed", "result": {"structured_content": {"stage": {"id": "confirm-rewards"}}}}}])
            rows, _, _ = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)
            self.assertTrue(rows[0]["checkpoint_restored"])
            self.assertEqual(rows[1]["event"], "recovery_tool_completed")
            self.assertEqual(rows[1]["stage_id"], "confirm-rewards")

    def test_old_rotation_cannot_exhaust_current_failure_read_budget(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path.with_suffix(".jsonl.3"), [local("stage_decision", operation="act")] * 100_000)
            self.write(path, [failure("current_failure")])
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(path, max_source_lines=100_000)
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["error_code"], "current_failure")
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["source"], "worker.jsonl")
            self.assertEqual(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][-1]["lines_read"], 1)
            self.assertTrue(metadata["sources_oldest_first"][0]["scan_limited"])

    def test_controller_recovery_records_use_exact_event_whitelist(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [{"type": "axiom.controller_recovery", "event": event,
                               "stage_id": "confirm-rewards", "checkpoint_key": "a" * 64,
                               "mode": "codex", "reason": "excluded-secret"}
                              for event in ("stall_recovery_scheduled", "untrusted_event")])
            rows, _, content = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(len(rows), 1)
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["event"], "stall_recovery_scheduled")
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["checkpoint_key"], "a" * 64)
            self.assertNotIn(b"excluded-secret", content)

    def test_actual_recovery_tool_and_camel_error_are_supported(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {
                "type": "mcp_tool_call", "tool": "visionstudio_recover_stage",
                "status": "completed", "result": {"structuredContent": {"stage_id": "confirm-rewards"}}}},
                {"type": "item.completed", "item": {
                    "type": "mcp_tool_call", "tool": "visionstudio_observe",
                    "result": {"isError": True}}}])
            rows, _, _ = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(rows[0]["tool"], "visionstudio_recover_stage")
            self.assertEqual(rows[1]["event"], "tool_failed")

    def test_wrong_typed_fields_cannot_break_diagnostic_or_hide_later_failure(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl"
            self.write(path, [{"type": []},
                             {"type": "axiom.controller_recovery", "event": []},
                             local("stage_decision", operation=[]),
                             {"type": "axiom.controller_recovery", "event": "stall_recovery_scheduled", "mode": []},
                             {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "tool": "visionstudio_observe", "status": []}},
                             failure("later_failure")])
            rows, _, _ = self.snapshot(path)
            self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["error_code"], "later_failure")
            self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["source_line"], 6)

    def test_missing_history_is_reported_as_retained_scope_not_complete(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            rows, metadata, _ = self.snapshot(Path(directory) / "worker.jsonl")
            self.assertEqual(rows, [])
            self.assertEqual(metadata["sources_oldest_first"], [])
            self.assertFalse(metadata["complete_history"])
            self.assertFalse(metadata["atomic_snapshot"])

"""Verified frozen-worker replacement: durable gates, process proof, no click replay."""
from __future__ import annotations
import copy
import json
import queue
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import mock
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_controller as app_module
import visionstudio_controller_state as control
import visionstudio_supervision as policy
import test_bridge

TERMINAL = {"code": "archive_reset_required", "reason": "missing_loop_start_anchor", "retry_supervisor": False}

class StalledCheckpointRecoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self, root):
        server, session, desktop = test_bridge.VisionStudioBridgeTests().make_universal_scene(
            str(root), stage_id="multi-buy-target", random_boost_mode="targeted")
        self.addCleanup(server.close)
        ids = [s["id"] for s in session.mission["steps"] if not s.get("run_when")
               or "targeted" in s["run_when"]["random_mode"]]
        session.completed_stage_ids = ids[:ids.index("multi-buy-target")]
        session.committed_stage_ids = ["lobby-play", "select-random-boost-box", "open-multi-picker"]
        session.stage_action_attempts = {s: 1 for s in session.committed_stage_ids}
        session.actions = 3
        session.resume_required = False
        session.stage_action_replay_blocked = True
        session.pending_action_intent = {"intent_id": "uncertain-purchase", "stage_id": "multi-buy-target",
            "action": "click", "action_replay": "never", "action_number": 4, "target_id": "multi-buy-confirm"}
        session.loop_recovery_context = dict(loop_start_anchor_schema_version=3,
            loop_start_scene_id="lobby", loop_start_scene_variant="plain", loop_start_balance_known=True,
            lobby_coins_before=100000, loop_start_observation_number=1, loop_start_frame_sha256="a"*64,
            loop_start_retained_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            loop_start_mission_sha256=session.mission_contract_sha256,
            loop_start_plan_hash=session.mission["universal_plan"]["plan_hash"],
            loop_start_fixed_geometry_bounds=list(session.fixed_geometry_bounds),
            loop_start_witness_source="private-local-structural-lobby-classifier")
        cp = session.checkpoint_payload(status="active")
        # Real v0.18.15 checkpoint JSON omits this field; the durable anchor binds it.
        cp.pop("fixed_geometry_bounds", None)
        identity = {"mission_id": app_module.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_ID,
                    "revision": app_module.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_REVISION, "sha256": session.mission_contract_sha256}
        app = object.__new__(app_module.VisionStudioController)
        app.mission_var = SimpleNamespace(get=lambda: str(root / "mission.json"))
        app.worker_generation = 1
        app.auto_recovery_enforcing = False
        app.worker_continuation_queue = queue.Queue()
        app.next_worker_mode = None
        app._add_activity = mock.Mock()
        app._enqueue_worker_ui_log = mock.Mock()
        app._enqueue_worker_disk_log = mock.Mock()
        app._stats = mock.Mock(return_value=({}, cp))
        alive = [True]
        worker = mock.Mock(pid=321)
        worker.poll.side_effect = lambda: None if alive[0] else 0
        worker.wait.side_effect = lambda **_: alive.__setitem__(0, False) or 0
        worker.terminate.side_effect = lambda: self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["desired_state"], "blocked")
        app.worker = worker
        state = control.patch_state(app.control_path, desired_state="running",
            universal_config=session.universal_config, universal_plan=identity,
            fixed_geometry={"bounds": list(session.fixed_geometry_bounds), "source": "test"},
            batch_plan={"batch_id": "same-run", "status": "active", "requested_loops": None,
                        "completed_loops": 0, "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                        "universal_config": session.universal_config, "universal_plan": identity},
            worker={"status": "running", "mode": "local", "pid": 321,
                    "bridge_seen": True, "mission_started": True, "terminal_disposition": None,
                    "started_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"})
        return app, state, cp, desktop, alive

    def eligible(self, state, cp):
        return app_module.stalled_recovery_eligible(state, cp, health_name="UNRESPONSIVE", reader_alive=True)

    def test_live_checkpoint_with_no_resume_flag_and_pending_purchase_is_restore_eligible(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app, state, cp, desktop, _ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            before = copy.deepcopy(cp)
            self.assertIs(cp["resume_required"], False)
            self.assertNotIn("fixed_geometry_bounds", cp)
            self.assertTrue(self.eligible(state, cp))
            self.assertFalse(app_module.fresh_frame_health(state, frame_modified_at=None,
                now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()+100)[0])
            self.assertTrue(self.eligible(state, cp))
            self.assertEqual(cp, before)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_operator_boundaries_invalid_contract_and_unverified_startup_are_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, state, cp, _, _ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            mutations = {
                "disabled": lambda s,c: s.update(autonomous_recovery=False),
                "pause": lambda s,c: s.update(desired_state="pause_after_stage"),
                "stop": lambda s,c: s.update(desired_state="stop_requested"),
                "human": lambda s,c: c.update(paused_for_human=True),
                "terminal": lambda s,c: c.update(terminal_disposition=TERMINAL),
                "unknown_terminal": lambda s,c: c.update(terminal_disposition={"code":"unknown"}),
                "bridge": lambda s,c: s["worker"].update(bridge_seen=False),
                "mission": lambda s,c: s["worker"].update(mission_started=False),
                "schema": lambda s,c: s.update(_schema_write_blocked=True),
                "plan": lambda s,c: c.update(mission_contract_sha256="f"*64),
                "geometry": lambda s,c: s["fixed_geometry"]["bounds"].__setitem__(0, 999),
                "prefix": lambda s,c: c.update(completed_stage_ids=[]),
                "reset": lambda s,c: c.update(status="reset"),
                "malformed_budget": lambda s,c: s["worker"].update(auto_recovery_attempts=True),
            }
            for name, mutate in mutations.items():
                with self.subTest(name=name):
                    s,c = copy.deepcopy(state),copy.deepcopy(cp)
                    mutate(s,c)
                    self.assertFalse(self.eligible(s,c))

    def test_one_stall_restart_per_stable_checkpoint_but_later_loop_can_recover(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _, state, cp, _, _ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            cp["recovery_origin_session_id"] = cp["session_id"]
            state["worker"].update(auto_recovery_attempts=1, auto_recovery_key=policy.checkpoint_key(cp))
            cp.update(observations=cp["observations"]+1, resume_attempts=100, session_id="new-process")
            self.assertFalse(self.eligible(state,cp))
            cp.update(session_id="new-logical-loop", recovery_origin_session_id="new-logical-loop")
            self.assertTrue(self.eligible(state,cp))

    def test_replacement_closes_input_gate_then_queues_durable_restore_without_checkpoint_writes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,desktop,_ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            cpfile = Path(tmp)/"checkpoint-authority.json"
            cpfile.write_text(json.dumps(cp,sort_keys=True))
            before = cpfile.read_bytes(),copy.deepcopy(cp)
            app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            app.worker.terminate.assert_called_once()
            app.worker.wait.assert_called_once_with(timeout=3)
            final = control.read_state(app.control_path)
            self.assertEqual(final["desired_state"],"running")
            self.assertEqual(final["worker"]["mode"],"codex")
            self.assertEqual(final["worker"]["auto_recovery_key"],policy.checkpoint_key(cp))
            self.assertTrue(policy.persisted_universal_retry(final,cp))
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
            app.worker_reader_thread=None
            app._heart_worker_active=mock.Mock(return_value=False)
            app._launch_worker=mock.Mock()
            control.patch_state(app.control_path,worker={"recovery_next_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"})
            app._drain_worker_continuations()
            app._launch_worker.assert_called_once_with(resume=True,thread_id=None,worker_mode="codex")
            self.assertEqual((cpfile.read_bytes(),cp),before)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            events = [json.loads(x.args[0])["event"] for x in app._enqueue_worker_disk_log.call_args_list]
            self.assertEqual(events,["stall_recovery_input_locked","stall_recovery_scheduled"])

    def test_stop_and_human_winning_termination_race_cancel_restore(self):
        for desired in ("stop_requested","paused","human_verification"):
            with self.subTest(desired=desired),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                app,state,cp,desktop,alive = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
                def wait(**_):
                    alive[0]=False
                    control.patch_state(app.control_path,desired_state=desired)
                    return 0
                app.worker.wait.side_effect=wait
                before=copy.deepcopy(cp)
                app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
                self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["desired_state"],desired)
                self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
                self.assertEqual(cp,before)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_unconfirmed_termination_or_missing_handle_never_launches_a_second_worker(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,_,_ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            app.worker.terminate.side_effect=OSError("cannot terminate")
            app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            final=control.read_state(app.control_path)
            self.assertEqual(final["desired_state"],"blocked")
            self.assertEqual(final["worker"]["pid"],321)
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
            self.assertFalse(app.auto_recovery_enforcing)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,_,_ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            app.worker=None
            app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["revision"],state["revision"])
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())

    def test_refresh_attempts_verified_stall_recovery_even_with_no_fresh_frame_warning(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,_,_=self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            app._update_results=queue.Queue()
            app.settings_update=mock.Mock()
            app._drain_worker_log=mock.Mock()
            app._drain_worker_continuations=mock.Mock()
            app._drain_telegram_remote_commands=mock.Mock()
            app._promote_review_resolution=mock.Mock()
            app._register_blocked_review=mock.Mock(side_effect=lambda s,*_:s)
            app._next_update_check_monotonic=float("inf")
            for name in ("progress_text","metric_loops","metric_earnings","metric_net","metric_exp",
                         "metric_boxes","metric_recovery","stage_text","stage_phase_text",
                         "stage_phase_label","watchdog_text"):
                setattr(app,name,mock.Mock())
            app._latest_bridge_activity_modified_at=mock.Mock(return_value=None)
            app._latest_frame_modified_at=mock.Mock(return_value=None)
            app.worker_reader_thread=SimpleNamespace(is_alive=lambda:True)
            class EndRefresh(Exception): pass
            app.status_text=mock.Mock()
            app.status_text.set.side_effect=EndRefresh()
            with mock.patch.object(app_module,"fresh_frame_health",return_value=(False,"No fresh frame")), \
                 mock.patch.object(app_module,"startup_observation_timed_out",return_value=(False,"Already observed")):
                with self.assertRaises(EndRefresh): app._refresh_once()
            app.worker.terminate.assert_called_once()
            app.status_text.set.assert_called_once_with("AUTO-RECOVERING")
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())

    def test_new_batch_or_replacement_pid_winning_wait_cannot_inherit_old_claim(self):
        for replacement in ("batch","pid"):
            with self.subTest(replacement=replacement),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
                app,state,cp,_,alive=self.fixture(Path(tmp))
                def wait(**_):
                    alive[0]=False
                    if replacement=="batch":
                        batch=copy.deepcopy(state["batch_plan"]);batch["batch_id"]="new-batch"
                        control.patch_state(app.control_path,desired_state="blocked",batch_plan=batch)
                    else:
                        control.patch_state(app.control_path,desired_state="blocked",worker={"pid":999})
                    return 0
                app.worker.wait.side_effect=wait
                app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
                self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
                final=control.read_state(app.control_path)
                self.assertEqual(final["worker"]["pid"],999 if replacement=="pid" else 321)

    def test_new_run_winning_before_scheduler_return_cannot_receive_old_resume(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,desktop,_=self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            def new_run(*args,**kwargs):
                batch=copy.deepcopy(state["batch_plan"]);batch["batch_id"]="new-batch"
                return control.patch_state(app.control_path,desired_state="running",batch_plan=batch,
                    worker={"status":"starting","pid":999,"recovery_key":None,"recovery_next_at":None})
            with mock.patch.object(policy,"schedule_universal",side_effect=new_run):
                app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            final=control.read_state(app.control_path)
            self.assertEqual(final["batch_plan"]["batch_id"],"new-batch")
            self.assertEqual(final["worker"]["pid"],999)
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
            self.assertIsNone(app.next_worker_mode)
            events=[json.loads(x.args[0])["event"] for x in app._enqueue_worker_disk_log.call_args_list]
            self.assertEqual(events,["stall_recovery_input_locked"])
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_windows_tree_failure_blocks_even_when_parent_is_already_exited(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,desktop,alive = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            def taskkill(*args,**kwargs):
                self.assertEqual(args[0],["taskkill","/PID","321","/T","/F"])
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["timeout"],5)
                self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["desired_state"],"blocked")
                alive[0]=False
                return SimpleNamespace(returncode=1)
            nt = SimpleNamespace(name="nt",environ=app_module.os.environ)
            with mock.patch.object(app_module,"os",nt), mock.patch.object(app_module.subprocess,"run",side_effect=taskkill):
                app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["desired_state"],"blocked")
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
            app.worker.wait.assert_not_called()
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_windows_tree_success_requires_parent_exit_before_queue(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            app,state,cp,desktop,_ = self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            nt = SimpleNamespace(name="nt",environ=app_module.os.environ)
            with mock.patch.object(app_module,"os",nt), mock.patch.object(app_module.subprocess,"run",return_value=SimpleNamespace(returncode=0)) as kill:
                app._begin_stalled_auto_recovery(state)
            self.assertEqual(control.read_state(app.control_path)["desired_state"],"running")
            kill.assert_called_once()
            app.worker.wait.assert_called_once_with(timeout=3)
            self.assertTrue(app.worker_continuation_queue.empty())
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)

    def test_blocked_ui_does_not_claim_an_absent_automatic_retry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _,state,cp,_,_=self.fixture(Path(tmp))
            state["desired_state"]="blocked"
            state["worker"].update(status="blocked",terminal_disposition=TERMINAL)
            label,color,detail=app_module.worker_health(state,local_worker_active=False,checkpoint=cp)
            self.assertEqual(label,"RESET REQUIRED")
            self.assertIn("Archive / Reset",detail)
            state["worker"]["terminal_disposition"]=None
            self.assertEqual(app_module.worker_health(state,local_worker_active=False,checkpoint={})[0],"NEEDS REVIEW")
            self.assertEqual(app_module.blocked_recovery_status(state,{})[0],"NEEDS REVIEW")

if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
